node.statement: Uniform incompatible-corner product estimate. Let U in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k} and V in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, with k!=l. Since compression fixes its image and is within c_c e (for the universal constant in def-compressed-corner) of each parenthesized left-right multiplication, ||U-(p_j U)p_k||<=c_c e||U|| and ||V-p_l(V p_m)||<=c_c e||V||. Put A=p_j U and B=V p_m. The preceding projection bound and the product-norm axiom bound ||A||,||B||,||(A p_k)|| by universal multiples of ||U||,||V||. Replacing U,V by (A p_k),p_l B thus changes UV by O(e)||U||||V||. Twice applying the epsilon-associator gives (A p_k)(p_l B)=A((p_k p_l)B)+R, where ||R|| is at most a universal multiple of epsilon||U||||V||. The product-norm axiom and ||p_k p_l||<=4e bound the displayed main term by a universal multiple of e||U||||V||. Hence ||UV||<=K_inc e||U||||V||, with K_inc universal and independent of n.
